kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننحدر (form VII)
# نَنْحَدِرُ (nanḥadiru) /nan.ħa.di.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# نَنْحَدِرَ (nanḥadira) /nan.ħa.di.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
# نَنْحَدِرْ (nanḥadir) /nan.ħa.dir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَدَرَ (inḥadara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
